item.title: SwarmBase Announces SWARM Token Listing on MEXC Exchange for August 19
item.summary: SwarmBase announced its SWARM token will list on MEXC exchange on August 19, 2026 at 10:00 UTC, with an accompanying airdrop of 600,000 SWARM and 10,000 USDT, though listing details rely on a single self-reported source.
